## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or evidence.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run, their results, and any validation still required.
For measured behavior, link the raw report and identify the exact model and execution mode.

## Scope

State whether frozen runtime files, external artifacts or evidence boundaries changed.
Preserve upstream attribution and distinguish simulation, replay, HIL and physical hardware results.
